title: Warm German Sauerkraut Stew
description: A comforting, earthy German stew made with sauerkraut, onions, and a hint of soy sauce, served in a low-fat version
instructions: Heat oil in a large kadhai over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute more.
Add cabbage, carrots, potatoes, and sausage. Stir to combine.
Add apple cider vinegar and soy sauce. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Serve over egg noodles or rice, if desired.
Reheat any leftovers in the microwave or on the stovetop until heated through.
Freeze leftovers for up to 3 months.
To freeze, let the stew cool completely, then transfer it to a freezer-safe container or bag. Label and date the container or bag, then store it in the freezer until ready to reheat.
